title: Kitso Handshake v0.1 — Invitation artifact
description: A structured proposal from a Vacancy Agent to a Seeker Agent that the Seeker's principal consider engaging with the Vacancy. Carried as the Artifact of an A2A Task of type SeekerInvitation.

invitation_id.description: Unique identifier for this invitation, scoped to the issuing Vacancy Agent.

seeker_signals_matched.description: Signals on the Seeker side that the Vacancy Agent considered when issuing this invitation.

vacancy_signals_matched.description: Self-reported signals on the Vacancy side that align with the Seeker's stance.

score.description: Match score in the [0, 1] range, scale defined by the issuing agent.

narrative.description: Plain-language match summary suitable for surfacing to the Seeker's principal.

disclosed_so_far.description: Field paths the Vacancy side has revealed in this invitation, broken down by entity. Useful for the Seeker side to render what is and is not yet visible.

next_step_at_stake.description: What happens next if the Seeker's principal accepts, and what each side reveals at that step.

binding.description: Whether accepting this step creates a binding obligation for the principal. Binding steps require explicit human confirmation per the consent grammar.

human_in_loop_required.description: If true, the Seeker Agent MUST surface this invitation to the principal and obtain explicit confirmation before any reply is sent.
